title: REES spare parts Lima for B1F2 Laboratories
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP OTHER HCA.BUMED.NAVY MEDICINE WEST.NAVAL MEDICAL RESEARCH CENTER
detail_text: The purchase order will provide the detailed spare parts to enable over 40 new devices (freezers, incubators and room temperature/humidity): 1) Qty=15 Z3-NET 2) Qty=30 Z3-U1-00-ST-U (Z3 transmitter) 3) Qty=20 TPT2-CERT 4) Qty=10 TPT3-CERT 5) Qty=10 TPT4-CERT 6) Qty=6 CRYO-6 7) Qty=10 probe sensor for rooms (RH/TEMP) 8) Qty=6 probe sensor for rooms (RH/TEMP/Light) 9) Qty=30 TEMP-BLOCK
